overview: The Outer Ring forms the defensive perimeter of Shadow Haven. Built during the Terror of Luclin era, it houses guard barracks, faction checkpoints, and reinforced cavern gates.
history: Originally a simple cavern entrance, the Outer Ring was heavily fortified as tensions between Sanctus Seru and Katta Castellum escalated. The Haven Council expanded the perimeter to maintain neutrality and protect trade routes.
hooks: A Seru Loyalist checkpoint reports unusual arcane residue near the cavern gate.
A collapse in the Outer Ring reveals an ancient Luclin sub‑tunnel.
Katta diplomats request additional guard escorts due to rising tensions.
Underworks Delvers report tremors felt even in the Outer Ring.
A missing caravan prompts investigation into Outer Ring patrol routes.
